[build_author_reply](/app/openlibrary/catalog/add_book/__init__.py:212) queues new authors for saving, but not matched authors whose identifiers have been enriched.

The fix should try the Open Library key first, then external identifiers, then name and dates; reject conflicting values for the same identifier type; merge nonconflicting IDs and save the matched author; and preserve IDs on a newly created author. Existing [tests](/app/openlibrary/catalog/add_book/tests/test_load_book.py:90) cover name and date matching, but not these cases. Multiple identifier matches need an explicit, stable tie break; the current name matcher uses the lowest numeric author key.

VERDICT: FIX

The patch has two correctness gaps:

- [build_query](/app/openlibrary/catalog/add_book/load_book.py:324) and [build_author_reply](/app/openlibrary/catalog/add_book/__init__.py:240) require an author name. A record supplied with only an Open Library key or remote IDs therefore fails in the book import path. Allow identifier-only matches through both steps.
- [find_entity](/app/openlibrary/catalog/add_book/load_book.py:209) can choose a lower-key author whose other remote ID conflicts with the import, even when a compatible candidate exists. Exclude conflicting candidates before ranking, and handle IDs that identify different existing authors explicitly.

Relevant existing tests passed: `pytest -q openlibrary/catalog/add_book/tests/test_load_book.py openlibrary/catalog/add_book/tests/test_add_book.py` (122 passed) and `pytest -q openlibrary/tests/core/test_models.py openlibrary/plugins/upstream/tests/test_merge_authors.py` (40 passed). These cases remain uncovered. No `TEST_ENVIRONMENT_PROBLEM`; I made no project code changes.

Fixed the two review gaps. Book imports now accept authors identified only by an Open Library key or remote IDs. Remote ID matching skips candidates with conflicting IDs and raises `AuthorRemoteIdConflictError` when the supplied IDs identify different existing authors. I added regression tests for both cases.

Both reviewer test commands pass: 125 add-book tests and 40 core and author-merge tests. `git diff --check` is clean.
